title: Ana's Party
text:
Ana has a birthday party on Saturday. She writes an invitation for her friend Lucas. The invitation says the party starts at four o'clock in the afternoon. Ana asks Lucas to bring a cake.

Lucas reads the invitation and smiles. He wants to go, but he has a piano lesson at three o'clock. He writes back to Ana and says yes. He can come to the party after his lesson.

questions.text: What does Ana ask Lucas to bring?
What lesson does Lucas have at three o'clock?
Why will Lucas come to the party later than the start time?
options: He has a lesson before the party

questions.text: How does Lucas probably feel about the invitation?
options: He is happy to be invited
He is sad about the party

vocabulary.definition: a written card or message that asks someone to come to an event
an event where people meet to eat, drink and have fun
a time when someone teaches you something
a sweet food made from flour, sugar and eggs, often served at parties

paragraph_translations: Ana faz uma festa de aniversário no sábado. Ela escreve um convite para o seu amigo Lucas. O convite diz que a festa começa às quatro horas da tarde. Ana pede para Lucas trazer um bolo.
Lucas lê o convite e sorri. Ele quer ir, mas tem uma aula de piano às três horas. Ele responde para Ana e diz que sim. Ele pode ir à festa depois da aula.
